Video Frame Extractor

Video Frame Extractor

Scrub through a video and capture any frame as a PNG.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a video file from your device.
  2. Play it or drag the scrubber to the exact frame you want.
  3. Click "Capture frame".
  4. Preview the PNG below and click "Download PNG" to save it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What quality is the captured frame?

The frame is drawn from the video element to a canvas at the video's native resolution, then exported as a PNG — no quality is lost in the capture step.

Why does the scrubber sometimes jump slightly?

Some browsers restrict seeking precision, landing on the nearest keyframe. Scrub slowly for the most accurate positioning.

Is my video uploaded anywhere?

No. Your video is loaded locally in your browser and never uploaded anywhere.
